person: Abel Moreno, writing about his late father (made up)
summary: Only four memories. The member chose 'Other' and described the book in his own words. The agent should plan a few chapters, not pad the book out, and never invent anything to fill it (the father's name is never given).

memories.title: Dad's fishing hat
memories.body: Dad wore the same green fishing hat for twenty years. Mom threw it out once and he fished it out of the trash can and wore it to dinner.

memories.title: The Sunday he taught me to drive
memories.body: Dad taught me to drive in the empty lot behind the hardware store. He never raised his voice once, even when I backed into the cart corral.

memories.title: Dad meets Mateo
memories.body: The day Mateo was born, Dad held him for an hour and didn't say a word. Then he said, he has my ears, sorry kid.

memories.title: The last fishing trip
memories.body: Dad's last fishing trip was at Lake Orrin. He was too tired to cast, so I cast for him and handed him the rod. He caught the only fish of the day.
